command.configureWarnings.title: Configure Warning Thresholds
config.warningThresholds.description: Balance amounts (in your displayed currency) that trigger a low-balance warning. Configure interactively with the **DeepSeek: Configure Warning Thresholds** command, or edit here. Set to `[]` to disable optional warnings — a mandatory alert below $1 / ¥7 always stays on.
config.refreshIntervalMinutes.descriptio: How often the balance refreshes in the status bar, in minutes.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with DeepSeek Credit Status
walkthrough.description: Monitor your DeepSeek API credits in the status bar and never run out mid-session.
walkthrough.setApiKey.title: Set your API key
walkthrough.setApiKey.description:
Store your DeepSeek API key securely in VS Code SecretStorage. It is only ever sent to api.deepseek.com.
[Set API Key](command:deepseek-usage.setApiKey)
walkthrough.viewBalance.title: See your balance
walkthrough.viewBalance.description:
Your credits appear in the status bar and refresh automatically. Click the item for quick actions.
[Open Balance Menu](command:deepseek-usage.click)
walkthrough.configureWarnings.title: Configure low-balance warnings
walkthrough.configureWarnings.descriptio:
Choose the balance levels that should warn you. A mandatory alert below $1 / ¥7 is always on.
[Configure Warning Thresholds](command:deepseek-usage.configureWarnings)
